description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultStreamIdMapper class, which implements the IStreamIdMapper interface. It provides mechanisms to map stream IDs to grain key IDs based on stream properties and bindings, supporting GUID and integer key types.

classes.name: DefaultStreamIdMapper
classes.description: Implements IStreamIdMapper to map stream IDs to grain key IDs based on stream properties and type bindings.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Determines and returns the grain key ID span for a given stream ID based on configured grain bindings and stream ID properties.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Creates a GUID-based key for the stream ID, optionally including the namespace in the key.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an integer-based key for the stream ID, optionally including the namespace in the key.
